summary_1line: Bhima meets an old monkey blocking his path, fails to lift its tail, and humbly learns the monkey is Hanuman, his divine brother.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima strains with both arms to lift the old monkey’s tail on the forest path, sweating and grimacing while the monkey lies calmly before him.
The aged monkey lies across a narrow mountain path, casually blocking the way as the powerful Bhima stands before him in challenge.
Bhima, humbled, stands with folded hands before the monkey after failing to move the tail, realizing the being before him is extraordinary.
